name: fairy mist

attributes.attribute: dangerous at night or on bogs
omen of death in some legends

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fairy mist is an Irish folkloric motif. Like the Druid's Fog, the fairy mist hid people from sight. It rose suddenly and without warning. It proved most deadly after dark or across bogs and open wild ground. Some legends claim that to be surrounded by the fairy mist foretold death.

okr.objective: Fairy mist is an Irish folkloric motif of sudden concealment.
key_results: Fairy mist hid people from sight like the Druid's Fog.
